premise: Ladybug, Snail and Pinecone want to see the far meadow but it is too far for tiny legs; Deer kneels, carries them on his back, and walks so smoothly nobody slips.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: the biggest helps the smallest for no reward but company, and the ride is the adventure.
lesson: The biggest can carry the smallest, and both get somewhere new.

en-US.title: Deer Gives a Ride
en-US.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Past the stream was the sunny meadow. Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} wanted to see it. Snail {snail:pulse} wanted to see it. Pinecone {pinecone:pulse} wanted to see it. [sad] But Ladybug's wings were small, and Snail's foot was slow, and Pinecone could only roll downhill. Deer {deer:pulse} heard them sighing. He folded his long legs {deer:wobble 0.5} and knelt down in the grass. [curious] Climb on, he said. Ladybug on his ear. Snail on his back. Pinecone tucked between his shoulders. Mouse {mouse:hop} pushed Pinecone up. Then Deer stood up, slowly, and walked. {sfx:hooves} Clop… clop… clop… So smoothly that not one of them wobbled. Over the stream. Up the hill. Through the ferns. [excited] And there it was. {sfx:meadow} The sunny meadow, gold and green and buzzing. {ladybug:sparkle} {snail:sparkle} {pinecone:sparkle} [softly] Thank you, said three small voices. [happily] It was no trouble, said Deer. I wanted to see it too. He had never been there with friends before.

es-ES.title: Ciervo lleva a sus amigos
es-ES.text: {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Al otro lado del arroyo estaba el prado soleado. Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} quería verlo. Caracol {snail:pulse} quería verlo. Piña {pinecone:pulse} quería verlo. [sad] Pero las alas de Mariquita eran pequeñas, el pie de Caracol era lento, y Piña solo sabía rodar cuesta abajo. Ciervo {deer:pulse} los oyó suspirar. Dobló sus largas patas {deer:wobble 0.5} y se arrodilló en la hierba. [curious] Subid, dijo. Y subieron. Mariquita en su oreja. Caracol en su lomo. Piña entre sus hombros. Ratón {mouse:hop} le dio un empujoncito a Piña. Ciervo se levantó despacio y echó a andar. {sfx:hooves} Clop… clop… clop… Andaba tan suave que ninguno se tambaleó. Cruzó el arroyo. Subió la colina. Atravesó los helechos. [excited] Y allí estaba. {sfx:meadow} El prado soleado, dorado y verde y lleno de zumbidos. {ladybug:sparkle} {snail:sparkle} {pinecone:sparkle} [softly] Gracias, dijeron tres vocecitas. [happily] No ha sido nada, dijo Ciervo. Yo también quería verlo. Nunca había venido con amigos.

hooves.prompt: slow careful deer hooves stepping on soft grass and moss, three gentle clops

meadow.prompt: a wide sunny meadow, bees humming, grasshoppers and a warm breeze
